title: Yoisaki Kanade — Unformed Sound〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade, the rice porridge is ready.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Alright, we can stop being watchdogs now.
Let's get back to work.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We'll do what we can on our end, Kanade, so you get as much rest as you can.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry for making you worry, Ena, Mizuki. And thank you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If you're really sorry, then promise to stop doing stuff like this.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<What she said.
Let us know if anything else happens, Mafuyu!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I will. Anyway, I'm hanging up now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I also need to apologize to you, Rin.
Sorry for making you worry so much.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<It's okay...
For now, have some of this rice porridge.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Here you are. It's still hot, so be careful.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll have some now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What does rice porridge taste like, anyway?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... This one was made using eggs, so it tastes very gentle. It even brings out the sweetness in the rice.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hear that, Mafuyu...?
It sounds like she's going to finish it.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You need to eat something, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll have something once I've reached a good stopping point.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I vaguely remember Mafuyu saying that I need eat something while I was working on that song...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I thought I was getting enough to eat...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I ended up making Mafuyu cook this for me. The same goes for Ms. Mochizuki and her dishes. I caused them both so much trouble...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: For not eating what you made for me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In retrospect, I realize that I should have made myself clearer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... She means she won't hold back next time... Right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (For a second there, it sounded like she meant something else. But I'm sure I'm just imagining things.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And I don't want Mafuyu to become stressed because of something I did...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So, I need to be more careful moving forward...)
